name: Curse of Altered Perceptions
body:
Things tend to not be what they seem.

Bonus Spells: 0th—ghost sound, 1st—illusion of calm, 2nd—mirror image, 3rd—major image, 4th—phantasmal killer

Curse Manifestation

The lathspell exudes an aura that makes people, including the lathspell, have difficulty parsing what is real and what is not. All illusions spells that are within 10 feet of the lathspell, or targeting a space, creature or object within 10 feet of the lathspell, have their DCs increased by 1. Even the caster is affected by illusions if they are within the aura of the lathspell and must make Will saves to disbelieve them.

Curse Abilities
Aura of Emptiness (Su)

You may, as a swift action, push your spirit into the curse causing it to shift the light and shadow around you.

All creatures and unattended objects, excluding furniture and buildings, within the radius of your curse manifestation, including yourself, are invisible as per the spell invisibility. At 8th level, this instead acts as greater invisibility. Spells that reveal invisible creatures, such as see invisibility or true seeing, reveal creatures and objects under this effect. Ending the effect is a free action. Embedding your spirit within the curse in this way is draining and difficult to maintain. You may maintain the invisibility for 1 round per lathspell class level without suffering any ill effects. If you continue to maintain the invisibility past that duration you become fatigued. If you continue to maintain the effect for longer than 1 minute per 2 lathspell class levels (minimum 1), you become exhausted. If the effect is maintained for 10 minutes longer than the exhaustion duration, you fall unconscious. For each round spent maintaining the effect, you must spend 2 rounds recovering. Any unrecovered rounds are added to your total rounds maintained to determine your fatigue level. This special fatigue and exhaustion is a curse and represents a magical draining of the energies animating the lathspell. If you are normally immune to fatigue and exhaustion, you still suffer from the penalties of fatigue and exhaustion caused by this effect and you are still rendered unconscious if you reach that point. This is an illusion, glamer effect.

Blank Space (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

Your curse makes it difficult for even spellcasters to pierce what is real or not with their own divinations. You and all creatures, objects, and spaces within the radius of your curse manifestation are affected by the nondetection spell using your lathspell class level as the caster level.

Defensive Displacement (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

You may, as an immediate action displace your form in response to an enemy attack. This may trigger on any attack, spell or ability used against you that has an attack roll. If the attacker fails their Will saving throw, they have a 50% miss chance against you. Once a creature has been subject to this illusion, they are immune to it for 1 minute. This is an illusion, phantasm) effect.

Distraction Maneuvers (Su)

You may, as a swift action, create a static image of yourself to distract a foe while you turn invisible for a very short time.

You may move up to 5 feet per 5 class levels (minimum 5 feet) in this protected invisible state. You become visible at the end of the maximum distance or when you stop moving.

This allows you to avoid attacks of opportunity when moving from a threatened square while invisible. Each creature that would normally get an attack of opportunity may make a Will save to see through this glamer and attempt their attack of opportunity unless you use Acrobatics. This is an illusion, glamer effect.

Hallucinatory Flash (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 10th level or higher

The curse of altered perception begins to cause painful feedback on those piercing through the illusions in its radius. Anytime a creature, including the Lathspell, succeeds on a saving throw against an illusion effect or attempts to use a divination spell within the radius of the curse, the creature must make a Will save. On failure, they are dazed by the flash of scintillating color for 1 round, then dazzled for 1d4 rounds thereafter. If they succeed on the saving throw, they are only dazzled for 1d4 rounds. This hallucinatory flash is also triggered anytime a critical hit is confirmed within the radius, and both the target and the attacker must make the saving throw.
